summary: Approved sequence sheets for EP19 capsule blend lot L02 (WA/2011/192): six-month accelerated stability at 40 °C/75% RH against the 25 °C/60% RH reference. An emerging degradant at the warm condition grew between the pulls, and Esmervane revised the capsule moisture barrier before long-term testing. Conclusions stay within the tested interval.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: EP19 capsule blend: six-month accelerated stability

rows: Lot L02 stored at 40 °C/75% RH and at 25 °C/60% RH for six months. Pulls at 0, 3 and 6 months. Assay by HPLC as % label claim; impurities as % area.

Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0086:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. The warm condition showed an emerging degradant that grew over the six months. Esmervane asked for a higher moisture barrier on the capsule before long-term testing started.
Stability results and total impurities chart

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Ref. degradant peak at RRT 0.86 and 1.12 as set in the protocol.

sheets.name: Chamber
rows: Samples were stored in the capsule packaging supplied by Esmervane. Alarm limits were set to the chamber tolerance.
CH-4 ran the warm condition for the full six months. No unplanned alarms were recorded for CH-2 during the study.

sheets.name: Deviations
rows: Three-month pull for the 40 °C/75% RH condition taken one day late because of a weekend chamber service. Sample held at the set point; no impact on the result.
Water content by Karl Fischer repeated on one three-month sample after the first titration failed system suitability. Repeat result reported.
Capsule moisture barrier revised at client request before long-term testing. Recorded as a change, not a deviation.

comments.text: Chamber service dates confirmed with facilities. Closed.
